# Templates Overview

Use this directory for reusable starting points that are meant to be copied or adapted.

## What belongs here

- Single-file templates for repeatable docs or planning work
- Scaffold-support files that live alongside a reusable template pack
- Setup guides that explain how to use a bundled template directory

## What does not belong here

- Read-only examples
- Reference implementations meant only to be inspected
- Historical archives

## Current layout

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `sprint-structure.md` | Reusable sprint planning scaffold |
| `attachment-canonical-summary.md` | Canonical summary template for attachment-heavy sessions |
| `basecoat-memory/basecoat-shared-memory-setup.md` | Shared memory setup scaffold |
